metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Vera Wipeout
records.biography_en: Vera Wipeout booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. I meant to stop here. The incident report lists two short crossed skis held in arms as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I meant to stop here.

records.name: Ned Snowblind
records.biography_en: Ned Snowblind booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. The blue run moved. The incident report lists folded piste map with simple colored trails as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The blue run moved.

records.name: Gus Liftpass
records.biography_en: Gus Liftpass booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. I paid for both directions. The incident report lists oversized colorful pass on a short lanyard as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I paid for both directions.

records.name: Hal Hotchoc
records.biography_en: Hal Hotchoc booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. Wake me for the next cocoa. The incident report lists big cocoa mug with one fat marshmallow as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Wake me for the next cocoa.

records.name: Cora Snowglobe
records.biography_en: Cora Snowglobe booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. It snows indoors! The incident report lists small snow globe with a tiny cabin inside as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: It snows indoors!

records.name: Jules Snowplow
records.biography_en: Jules Snowplow booked a place with The Off Piste Beginners. The board looks faster than I am. The incident report lists short bright snowboard hugged across belly as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The board looks faster than I am.
